gold: Trifascicular block (Right bundle-branch block with alternating left anterior and left posterior fascicular block)

selector.rationale: Evidence of conduction abnormalities on ECG, including right bundle-branch block and fascicular blocks, with no significant orthostatic changes or other contradicting findings.

rejected.label: Orthostatic hypotension
rejected.why: Stable vital signs without considerable orthostatic changes in blood pressure and heart rate

rejected.label: Hypertensive heart disease
rejected.why: Mild concentric left ventricular hypertrophy but no acute pathologic changes or significant contradicting findings

rejected.label: Sick sinus syndrome
rejected.why: No significant evidence of sinus node dysfunction despite some ECG findings

rejected.label: Bifascicular block
rejected.why: While present, it is a subtype of cardiac conduction disease and the latter provides a broader explanation for the patient's symptoms and ECG findings
